patch_list: Adds ARM64 builds of the game's libGDX 1.1.0 libraries for 64-bit-only Android devices.
Adds a coin button below Gameplay Challenge on the tuning screen to set and save the balance.
Enables the engine's immersive mode to hide system bars during play, including after returning to the game.
Allows both landscape directions when rotating the phone through 180 degrees.
Unlocks the second map, Bora Bora, by default without spending coins.
